map_M.domain: the swept slab z in [0, z_f(t)] of U; z outside it is untouched and absent from u
map_M.coordinates: u on the body cross-section uses (x,y) in m centred on the slice; u on the array uses raster site index
map_M.single_valued: YES, by a declared bijection: layer k -> site k in raster order. One layer occupies one site.
map_M.competition_rule: no layer competes for a site: the 1.457 components are the pieces of ONE layer sharing that layer's single site, so the site holds 1 or 2 fragments of the same slice
map_M.markov: NO as written. History enters through the accumulated deposit and the interface position. With the extended state (deposited field, z_f, decayed front z_f - v tau) the map is instantaneous; that extended state is declared, not proved minimal.
